qs.q: Superoxide dismutase (SOD) converts superoxide anion to:
qs.e: SOD converts O2•− to H2O2 and O2 (2O2•− + 2H+ → H2O2 + O2). The H2O2 must then be degraded by catalase or glutathione peroxidase to water. SOD doesn't produce hydroxyl radicals or water directly. This is the first step in the cellular defense against ROS.
